prompt_head:
Role: Forward Deployed Engineer (Fort Lauderdale/Miami) at TribalScale
<requirements>
[r1] (required, other) Professional experience building and deploying prod

assessments.note: Built full agent pipeline with tool‑calling.
Orchestration skills present, no explicit graph/state‑machine details.
Backtesting shows evaluation ability but lacks full AI benchmark suite.
Understands prompts and tool use; deeper trade‑off knowledge not shown.
Data‑validation pipelines indicate instrumentation, but AI‑specific tracing not explicit.
Strong API, cloud, and modern dev practice experience.
Broad experience shows quick learning capability.
Created prototype pipeline and validated it.
Prompt expertise hints at product judgment, but balance aspects not demonstrated.
Education mentions communication focus, but concrete examples missing.
Project‑management cert suggests travel readiness, no explicit travel record.
Based in South Florida, matches location.
Experience delivering solutions with customers and teams.

output.verdict_line: The candidate broadly meets the technical and soft‑skill requirements but lacks depth in evaluation and instrumentation of AI systems.
top_gaps: Instrumenting AI decisions for tracing and diagnostics (r7)
